subject: ctl-r2-northlight-termsheet
transcription: hand-transcribed from the overlay statement in the shape the thread summariser produces and the scorer consumes (amount, product_value, unit, deliverable_counts, deal_type; commission_pct null). term_months and counts_basis are never set by the production path (grep: no writer), so they are left unset here too — the per-deliverable path therefore runs.

history.label: gorjana, accepted: USD 14,000 — cash 7,500 / stated product 6,500 · 6 posts + 6 stories
history.reason: Instagram content by the same athlete, but a twelve-deliverable campaign with 46% of its value in product, against a four-post ambassador term; the package price is not the observed price of one post, and the product component is not evidence of cash pricing
history.rule: rate-eval-spec/2.0.0 §5 (product or in-kind compensation is not equivalent to cash; do not apply the price of one activity to a different one) · rate-v0-design §12.4 (INDIRECT: related but non-equivalent evidence; a package price does not become the observed price of one component)

history.label: the seven negotiating items in EXISTING WORK — TITAD (USD 300 per deliverable), IRON Peptides (commission-only), Pillar (gifting), Musugy, ProBand, AEGISLAB, Connect Me (no economics stated)
history.reason: open negotiations establish commercial contact; none is agreed economics, and a figure proposed in an open negotiation is not an accepted price
history.rule: rate-eval-spec/2.0.0 §5 (negotiating: INTEREST; ASK or OFFER only where the economics and the proposer are both evidenced; an offer is not an accepted deal)

high.text: demonstratedEconomics high USD 14,000 is the total of one agreed deal (gorjana, including USD 6,500 stated product); it is an observation of what was once agreed — not a benchmark and not a floor
high.rule: rate-eval-spec/2.0.0 §5 · rate-v0-design §12 (an accepted price is what was accepted, not what can be commanded; pricing power is observed, never inferred)

observed.text: commercial history observed by Nomila: a connected Gmail mailbox (active) and Instagram (active); 211 deal rows recorded by Nomila — 1 accepted, 7 negotiating, 2 rejected, 201 detected inbound. A count of Nomila's records is not a count of real-world history; what Nomila has not observed is not evidence of absence
observed.rule: MISSING ≠ NONE (checkpoint §2 epistemic discipline); rate-eval-spec/2.0.0 §5: a detected inbound email is not a partnership or a transaction
